goal: Speed up initial block download and reindexing by reading upcoming blocks from disk in the background
Prevents slow disk reads from stalling the validation thread while connecting blocks
agreement: Verified speedups on initial block download and reindexing benchmarks across multiple machines (andrewtoth)
Concept approval after verifying concurrency safety with block writes, pruning, and indexes (arejula27)
Approval after earlier concerns on invalid branch caching and settings were resolved (w0xlt)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it noticeably accelerates block connection during reindexing and initial sync
Node operators on HDDs see up to 1.53x reindex speedups and SSDs see up to 1.30x reindex speedups
